remember to leave hearts and reviews <3

~ Vixon's recipe for Vietnamese Rice Paper Shrimp Rolls ~

Ingredients

Rice Paper Shrimp Rolls

15 sheets of round rice paper

55 small shrimp, cooked - 3 shrimps per roll

1 pack of dried vermicelli noodles

15 portioned lettuce leaves

Peanut Sauce

½ cup smooth peanut butter

1 tbsp sugar

4 tbsp hoisin sauce

1 tbsp soy sauce

2 small garlic cloves, minced

2 tbsp lime juice

Instructions

Cook the shrimp and noodles. Get a large bowl and fill with warm water. Place your rice paper into the water to soak until they're soft.

Place three shrimps, a leaf of lettuce, and your noodles onto your rice paper and roll them up as pictured above (sides first then roll in from the bottom).

For the dipping sauce, start with 2 tbsp of water and add in all the peanut sauce ingredients. As you mix, add additional water until the consistency is just a bit thicker than ketchup.

items.name: LiquidCloud_液流云_SDXL_V1
items.description:
LiquidCloud_液流云_SDXL_V1

LiquidCloud is an interesting model that can artistically transform objects with liquid, fluid, and curved features, creating a more fluid, layered, and three-dimensional image. LiquidCloud is suitable for most artistic styles and can easily generate colorful works, while also having a certain aesthetic function for characters.

How to use it?

  • 1. Generally speaking, it is sufficient to use prompt words that match this style normally. Here are some relevant prompt words that I hope can provide you with some inspiration.

    Liquid wave, paint wave, splashing, surround, splash, whirlpool, colorful, liquid cloud, water wave, bubble, layered design, curved design, abstract, floating, droplet

  • 2. Lora Strength recommends a range of 0.3 to 0.7.

LiquidCloud是一款有趣的模型，它可以把具有液体、流体、曲线特征的物体艺术化，创造出更有流动性、层次感和立体感的画面。LiquidCloud适合大部分艺术风格，可以轻易的生成色彩丰富的作品，同时对人物也具有一定的美颜功能。

如何使用？

  • 一般来说，正常使用与这种风格相匹配的提示词就足够了。以下是一些相关的提示语，希望能给你一些启发：

    Liquid wave, paint wave, splashing, surround, splash, whirlpool, colorful, liquid cloud, water wave, bubble, layered design, curved design, abstract, floating, droplet

  • Lora Strength 建议0.3-0.7之间。

Finally, I hope you can enjoy it and create great works.
